scenario: A 23 years male, very lean and less weight. He needs muscle/body growth.

amway_product.name: Amway XS Whey Protein Formula 2 Chocolate
amway_product.description: A multi-stage protein utilizing a blend of 6 different protein sources, including fast-absorbing Whey Hydrolysate/Isolate and slower-digesting Caseinates, ensuring sustained muscle nourishment with prebiotic digestive comfort.
amway_product.scientific_truths: Contains 23g of intact protein per 30g serving with 5g BCAAs, 80mg calcium, and prebiotics. Matches the clinical leucine threshold to trigger maximal muscle protein synthesis without metabolic renal waste.

medical_standards_validation.standard_authority: International Society of Sports Nutrition (ISSN) & ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA

verification_table.fit_assessment: Matches the exact leucine threshold (~2.5g) to trigger maximal Muscle Protein Synthesis (MPS) in young adults.
Clinically validated 2:1:1 ratio necessary to suppress exercise-induced muscle protein breakdown.

verification_table.standard_measurement: 0.5 – 2.0 g per dose (EFSA & NIH Digestibility Benchmark)
verification_table.fit_assessment: Mitigates gastrointestinal distress and bloating commonly triggered by concentrated dairy proteins.
Supplies safe baseline for neuromuscular contraction without competing with dietary iron absorption.

verification_table.standard_measurement: < 25.0 g/day or < 5% total energy (WHO / ICMR Standards)
verification_table.fit_assessment: Zero glycemic spike; preserves insulin sensitivity and avoids empty calories.

who_may_use: Lean individuals (ectomorphs) seeking hypertrophy & muscle mass accretion
Resistance-trained athletes requiring targeted post-workout recovery
Adults seeking sustained daytime and nocturnal amino acid delivery
Individuals prone to GI bloating with standard single-source whey
who_should_not_use: Individuals with severe dairy / milk protein anaphylaxis or allergy
Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD stage 3+) without nephrologist consult
Infants and children under 12 years of age
amway_product.usp: Unique blend of 6 protein sources for sustained release + Prebiotics for zero bloating.

worthiness: Validated against International Society of Sports Nutrition (ISSN) and ICMR-NIN benchmarks, Amway XS Whey fits medical criteria for optimal muscle protein synthesis (23g per bolus) while resolving typical protein bloating via prebiotics.

medical_evidence.title: ISSN Position Stand: Protein and Exercise
